title: Data Security dashboards: channel views (Inline CASB, Inline DLP, SaaS, Endpoint, Email) and sensitive data at rest

prose.text: {{views}} Where Inline CASB's incidents come from differs between two pages {{divergence:inline-casb-source}}. The reports these dashboards open are in [[zia.reports.data-protection]], and the Incidents view is described in [[zwa.incident-analytics]].

prose.label: Time range.
prose.text: {{time-range}} The Inline CASB and Inline DLP pages state no time-range filter {{gap:page-details}}.

prose.label: Data Security dashboard.
prose.text: {{incident-types}} {{data-at-rest}} Data security posture management is in [[dspm.overview]].

checks.do: Where the Inline CASB dashboard's incidents come from, since the Analytics overview and the dashboard page name different sources.

views.statement: Under Data Security, Analytics lists Inline CASB, Inline DLP (incidents from inline web sources), SaaS Security (incidents from SaaS applications), Endpoint (incidents from endpoints, for example printers, network shares and removable storage), Email (incidents from email) and Incidents (high-level visibility into DLP incidents).

quotes: Inline CASB: Provides detailed information about data loss incidents from
Inline DLP: Provides detailed information about data loss incidents from inline (web) sources in your organization.
SaaS Security: Provides detailed information about data loss incidents from SaaS applications in your organization.
Endpoint: Provides detailed information about data loss incidents from endpoints (e.g., printers, network shares, removable storage) in your organization.
Email: Provides detailed information about data loss incidents from email that affect your organization.
Incidents: Provides high-level visibility and insight into your organization's Data Loss Prevention (DLP) incidents.

time-range.statement: The Data Security, SaaS Data Security and Endpoint dashboards take a time range between 1 Day and 30 Days and the Email Data Security dashboard between 1 Day and 7 Days; each applies it to all data in the dashboard and defaults to 7 Days.

quotes: between 1 Day and 30 Days in which to view data
The selected period applies to all data within the dashboard.
The default time range is 7 Days.

between 1 Day and 7 Days in which to view data

incident-types.statement: The Data Security dashboard's Total Incidents donut and Users with Most Incidents chart break data loss incidents into Inline DLP (inline web sources), SaaS (SaaS applications), Endpoint (printers, network shares, etc.) and Email; clicking a channel opens a dashboard with more detail about incidents on that channel.

quotes: This donut chart shows the total number of data loss incidents that occurred in your organization.
This bar chart shows the users with the most data loss incidents.
Click a channel to open a dashboard with more detail about incidents on that channel.
Inline DLP: Data loss incidents from inline (web) sources.
SaaS: Data loss incidents from SaaS applications.
Endpoint: Data loss incidents from endpoints (printers, network shares, etc.).
Email: Data loss incidents from email.

data-at-rest.statement: Top Sensitive Data at Rest shows the total sensitive data at rest by category (such as social security information, HIPAA data and PCI data), the file count per category across public clouds, on-premises or SaaS, and links to the Data Inventory page; it filters by Channels (Public Clouds, On-Premises, SaaS), AI Classification (sensitive data exposed to AI models and services, classified using DLP engines; the Exact AI Type checkbox shows a Gen AI Category filter) and DLP Engines.

quotes: This widget shows the total amount of sensitive data at rest in your organization
along with each category of data such as social security information, HIPAA data, personal card information (PCI) data, and more
Click each bubble to view the total number of files containing sensitive data across public clouds, on-premises, or SaaS.
Click the number to view additional file details on the Data Inventory page.
Channels: Click this filter to narrow the view to only data at rest in either Public Clouds, On-Premises, or SaaS.
AI Classification: View only sensitive data that is exposed to AI models and services, such as financial or medical documents.
This sensitive data is classified using DLP engines.
Select the Exact AI Type checkbox to display the Gen AI Category filter
DLP Engines: View data at rest detected by DLP engines

inline-casb.statement: The Inline CASB Data Security dashboard shows GenAI applications by data volume and by number of transactions, and two tables of applications with the biggest risk of data loss: those with the lowest usage and those with the highest usage by users, each with a colour-coded risk index from 4 (riskiest, red) to 1 (least risky, green), the number of users and a recommended action.

quotes: This donut chart shows the data used by GenAI applications across your organization.
This donut chart shows the number of transactions created by GenAI applications across your organization.
This table shows the list of applications that have the biggest risk of data loss and the lowest usage by your users.
This table shows the list of applications that have the biggest risk of data loss and the highest usage by your users.
from riskiest (risk index 4, red) to least risky (risk index 1, green)
Users: The number of users who used this application within the current time range.
Action: The recommended action for this application.
evidence.after: - Top High Risk Applications to Eliminate

quotes: from riskiest (risk index 4, red) to least risky (risk index 1, green)
Users: The number of users who used this application within the current time range.
Action: The recommended action for this application.
evidence.after: - Top High Risk Applications to Secure

inline-dlp.statement: The Inline DLP Data Security dashboard shows the total incidents involving Inline DLP policy violations, the top types of sensitive inline DLP data, and a Sankey chart of sensitive files in the top 10 ML categories that links to the Data Discovery Report filtered for machine learning categories.

quotes: This widget shows the total number of incidents involving Inline DLP policy violations across your organization.
This bar chart shows the top types of sensitive inline DLP data in your organization.
Sensitive Files in Top 10 ML Categories
This Sankey diagram shows information about files within various machine learning categories within your organization.
Click View All Data Discovery to open the Data Discovery Report, filtered for machine learning categories.

saas.statement: The SaaS Data Security dashboard (Analytics > Data Security > SaaS Security) breaks SaaS incidents down, on hover, as Private (compromising personal information), Internal (a security breach within the organization) and External (originating outside), and shows the Application Tenant Name responsible for a data loss incident.

quotes: Private: Incidents that compromise personal information.
Internal: Incidents that represent a security breach within your organization.
External: Incidents that originated outside your organization.
The SaaS Data Security dashboard (Analytics > Data Security > SaaS Security)
Application Tenant Name: The application responsible for a data loss incident.

endpoint.statement: The Endpoint data security dashboard filters by Status (Allowed or Blocked), shows the types of endpoints most commonly responsible for incidents and the endpoints most responsible for sensitive data exposure by DLP engines or ML categories, and links to the Endpoint DLP Report.

quotes: Status: Use this filter to show only incidents that were Allowed or Blocked.
Chart segments show the types of endpoints most commonly responsible for the incidents.
This bar chart shows the endpoints most responsible for sensitive data exposure in your organization.
Click DLP Engines to categories based on DLP engines, or ML Categories to view based on machine learning categories.
Click View Endpoint Activity to open the Endpoint DLP Report to explore in more detail.

email.statement: The Email Data Security dashboard shows the total incidents involving Outbound Email DLP policy violations and the top email domains to which data has been exposed, and links to the Email Security Report.

quotes: This widget shows the total number of incidents involving Outbound Email DLP policy violations across your organization.
This bar chart shows the top email domains to which data has been exposed.
Click View Email Security Activity to open the Email Security Report to explore in more detail.

inline-casb-source.summary: The Analytics overview says the Inline CASB entry covers data loss incidents from web applications; the Inline CASB dashboard page says it covers incidents from SaaS Security API sources.

quotes: Inline CASB: Provides detailed information about data loss incidents from web applications in your organization.

positions.says: Inline CASB: data loss incidents from web applications.

quotes: provides detailed information about data loss incidents from SaaS Security API sources in your organization

positions.says: Inline CASB dashboard: data loss incidents from SaaS Security API sources.

inline-casb-source.impact: An operator cannot tell from the pages whether the Inline CASB dashboard shows inline web traffic incidents or API-scanned SaaS incidents; the SaaS Security dashboard is listed separately as covering incidents from SaaS applications.

page-details.title: Data Security dashboard details the pages leave open
page-details.detail: The Inline CASB and Inline DLP pages state no time-range filter. The Total Incidents donut lists four channels and not Inline CASB. The pages do not say which subscription Top Sensitive Data at Rest needs, and the Data Inventory page it links to has no subject.
